reviews.comment: Dr. C very clearly understands the topic like the back of his hand and is good at teaching it, However, some of the demand to learn topics that are on the homework but not covered in class can be a bit ridiculous. His exam grading can also be a bit overly harsh. The practice exams he gives are very good but he often doesn't post solutions.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Chak is extremely intelligent and the lectures are helpful and recorded but he's overall just very strict and straight up disrespectful to students at times. His grading on exams makes no sense and the homework can be very demanding later in the semester. He can be generous with bonus points on exams and potential end of class curves.

Dr. Chakravorty, outside of the classroom is a great guy, however, his teaching can be quite... aggressive. His lectures are straightforward and he is very clear about his expectations. HW can be tedious and exams are fine, but he doesn't give a lot of feedback.

Dr. Chakravorty is a semi-decent lecturer, but his exam grading methodology is often unclear and inconsistent, and in a class where exams are worth 80% of the class grade, the apparent lack of partial credit can really hurt.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The biggest problem with Dr. Chak is the fact that he refuses to tell you why you lost points on your exams. He doesn't use a rubric when he grades, rather he simply examines your paper and assigns a score, and expects you to figure out why you lost points. The Chak also has a pretty nasty temper sometimes. However, his lectures are very helpful.

Chak is very strict, he likes things his way and will let you know if you are out of order - either verbally or in grading. There is NO partial credit. On the final, every question is all or nothing. Homework is also graded harshly. That being said, Chak is a good professor, but in the end your grade might not reflect your knowledge of the material
You will have to learn yourself.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The TA only seemed to grade one or two questions per homework and we were never given correct solutions to problems. You're expected to know what you did wrong by... magic I guess? Several miscommunications happened between the professor and the TA and Chakravorty would blame the class for asking the TA and not him instead. Very hostile environment

This guy is extremely rude. His homework's are extremely long, difficult, vague, and he barely gives any complete solutions. Only does one problem over and over again during lecture. The final is worth 40%. Throws temper tantrums when we complain about homework concerns and when most of the class fails a test. He often makes many lecture mistakes.
Practice exams are almost identical to the real test (like some problems are actually identical). Lectures are clear. Class is heavily curved
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: only 3 tests and 1 hw a week. class is heavily curved and the average is a high B to low A
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He knows the material very well and does a decent job at explaining it. Textbook is helpful to supplement his lectures, which are not very exciting but is a consequence of the material. Would definitely sit down and have a beer with Chak.

While seemingly apathetic towards the course and the students, Dr. C does do a fair job of explaining what is really a very difficult set of concepts. His practice exams are very close in structure and content to his real exams. If you read the textbook (when he actually uses it) and make use of his office hours, you can get through it just fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. C walks into the classroom, will assign a problem, then leave without explaining the problem, expecting us to figure it all out on our own. He does not seem to care for the students in the slightest. The later HW's are near impossible, which is frustrating when combined with his method of teaching, or lack thereof.
